body: ParseHTTPConfig panics when the timeout field is missing from ledgerd.yaml; always set http.timeout explicitly.
All money amounts are int64 minor units (cents). Never use float64 for amounts anywhere in the ledger.
Integration tests need Postgres 16; start it with make db-up before go test ./internal/store/... and stop it with make db-down.
We chose NATS JetStream over Kafka for the event bus because ops already runs NATS and our volume is under 2k msgs/sec.
Migrations run in filename order; a new migration must have a higher timestamp prefix than every existing one or goose silently skips it.
Errors returned from the store layer are wrapped with fmt.Errorf and %w; handlers map store.ErrNotFound to HTTP 404 and store.ErrConflict to 409.
The idempotency key header is Idempotency-Key; keys are stored for 24 hours in the idempotency_keys table.
The ledger balance query must take a FOR UPDATE lock on the account row, otherwise concurrent transfers can overdraw the account.
To regenerate the OpenAPI client run make generate; never edit files under internal/api/gen by hand.
Currency conversion rates come from the fxrates service and are cached in memory for 5 minutes.
Structured logging uses slog with snake_case keys; never log full card numbers or account numbers, only the last four digits.
The CI runner has no Docker socket, so testcontainers-based tests must be skipped with the integration build tag in CI.
Rounding for currency conversion uses banker's rounding (round half to even) per finance team requirement.
Feature flags live in LaunchDarkly; local development reads flags from flags.local.json instead.
The reconciliation job runs nightly at 02:00 UTC and compares ledger totals with the bank settlement CSV.
The settlement CSV from the bank uses semicolons as separators and comma decimal marks; parse it with the custom reader in internal/settlement/csv.go.
HTTP handlers take a context and must respect cancellation; do not start goroutines in handlers without passing ctx.
Rate limiting is 100 requests per minute per API key, enforced by the ratelimit middleware with Redis.
Redis connections leak if you forget to call Close on the subscription returned by PubSub; use defer sub.Close().
Release by tagging vX.Y.Z on main; the release workflow builds images and pushes to the internal registry.
Account IDs are ULIDs, not UUIDs, so they sort by creation time in indexes.
time.Now() must go through the injected clock (clock.Now) in ledger code, or tests of interest accrual become flaky.
Interest accrues daily using actual/365 day count and is posted on the first of each month.
Database queries are written with sqlc; put new queries in internal/store/queries/*.sql and run make sqlc.
sqlc generates pgtype.Numeric for NUMERIC columns; convert with numeric.ToInt64 helper, not by string parsing.
To replay a failed webhook delivery, call POST /admin/webhooks/{id}/replay with an admin token.
Webhook payloads are signed with HMAC-SHA256; the signature is in the X-Ledger-Signature header.
Webhook retries use exponential backoff capped at 1 hour, max 12 attempts; after that the delivery is marked dead.
Every new public endpoint needs an entry in docs/api.md and a contract test in internal/api/contract_test.go.
We do not support partial refunds yet; refunds always reverse the full original transfer.
The admin UI is a separate repo (ledger-admin); this repo only serves the JSON admin API.
Go 1.26 is required; the loopvar semantics matter in internal/batch where goroutines capture loop variables.
Profile a slow endpoint with go tool pprof against /debug/pprof on port 6060, enabled only when LEDGERD_DEBUG=1.
The batch transfer endpoint accepts at most 500 transfers per request and processes them in one database transaction.
Table-driven tests with t.Run subtests; use testify require for preconditions and assert for checks.
The fxrates client returns 0 for unknown currency pairs instead of an error; check for zero before converting.
Customer emails are sent through Postmark using templates stored in templates/email; template IDs live in config.
Run the linter with make lint; it uses golangci-lint with the config in .golangci.yml and fails on new issues only.
Soft-delete accounts by setting closed_at; never hard-delete rows from accounts because the ledger references them.
Closing an account must fail if the balance is non-zero; the API returns 409 with code account_not_empty.
Metrics are exported in Prometheus format on /metrics; transfer latency is the ledger_transfer_seconds histogram.
Config is loaded once at startup into a Config struct; do not read environment variables anywhere else.
The local Postgres in docker-compose listens on 5433, not 5432, to avoid clashing with a host Postgres.
Seed a local database with demo accounts using go run ./cmd/seed after make db-up.
Postgres integration tests need version 16 because we use MERGE; start the DB with make db-up first.
